# Security policy

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub private
vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/AlgoGators/algosystem/security/advisories/new).
Private reporting is enabled for this repository. Include the affected version,
steps to reproduce, the possible impact, and a suggested fix if you have one.

Please avoid posting vulnerability details in a public issue or pull request
before the maintainers have had a chance to investigate and coordinate a fix.
The maintainers will use the private advisory to discuss the report and share
updates. We ask reporters to allow up to 90 days for coordinated public
disclosure, or to agree on a different timeline with the maintainers.
